content:
samir: deploy-bot blocked publish for image redwood/runtime:2026.03.19 — deploybot reported provenance label mismatch: manifest label 'service-version=1.2.0' != attestation label 'service-version=1.2.1'. Skipping promotion. Any quick suggestions? cc @release-eng
deploy-bot: [bot] publish blocked for gcr.io/redwood/runtime:2026.03.19
reason: PROVENANCE_LABEL_MISMATCH
manifest.labels.service-version=1.2.0
attestation.labels.service-version=1.2.1
action: hold for manual review
tanvi: @samir can we pin to last successful digest and proceed with deploy while we fix attestations?
jess: if we republish with corrected labels we will get a new digest and need a fresh cosign attestation. Safer to pin to the known-good digest for now and update release notes explaining the pin.
samir: ok pulling last-good digest from staging — running:
```
gcloud container images list-tags gcr.io/redwood/runtime --filter="tags:staging" --limit=1 --format="get(digest)"
```
Got: sha256:0a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b
mike: ops question — pinning will bypass the attestation check for promotion? we should get a sign-off from security + ops since provenance check is being bypassed. It's 22:00 PST, change window considerations.
tanvi: we can do an emergency small change window. Only promote the pinned digest to staging, not to production, then rebuild overnight with correct labels and re-attest for tomorrow morning canary.
deploy-bot: manual action required: `publishbot promote --image gcr.io/redwood/runtime@sha256:0a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b --reason "pin-due-to-attestation-mismatch"`
jess: +1. After promote, open a PR to fix the build pipeline label injection and add a CI guard so mismatched attestation fails the build earlier.
samir: proceeding to promote pinned digest to staging now. I will update release-notes with a short entry and include rollback instructions.
mike: SGTM. Please add timeline, approvers, and quick rollback steps in the release note.
samir: rollback snippet for k8s: `kubectl set image deployment/runtime runtime=gcr.io/redwood/runtime@sha256:deadbeefcafebabefeedface000111222333444555` — rollback target is previous canary digest.
tanvi: i've drafted a release-note blurb: "Pin runtime image for staging due to provenance label mismatch; rebuild and re-attest planned for 09:00 UTC tomorrow. No production promotion during this window." added to docs/release-drafts.
security-bot: audit: event recorded for thread 2112345678 — publish-hold triggered by deploy-bot, attestation-id=0x9f8a7b, action=manual-review-required.
samir: thanks all, promoted to staging pinned digest and updated release-notes. Opening PR to fix label generator. Will tag @security and @ops when attestation re-run completes. :thumbsup:
